item.title: Airport chaos: Police gun discharges at Sydney Airport; probe underway
item.description: A police officer's firearm was discharged at Sydney Airport during an attempted arrest, causing a brief disruption. The incident occurred as a man allegedly tried to seize the officer's weapon, leading to a lockdown of the dining area. Authorities have launched an investigation, confirming no injuries and the resumption of normal airport operations, with no ongoing threat to the public.

item.title: NYC Mayoral race: From Zohran Mamdani to Eric Adams - What the latest poll reveals?
item.description: A recent Siena poll indicates Zohran Mamdani, the Democratic mayoral candidate, holds a significant lead in New York City with 44% support, while former Governor Andrew Cuomo trails at 25%. Mamdani garners strong support from younger voters and city Democrats, contrasting with Cuomo's favor among older voters.

item.title: Russia-US peace talks: Zelenskyy has been sidelined from the upcoming meeting - Here's why
item.description: Donald Trump will meet Vladimir Putin to discuss ending the Ukraine war. The meeting, requested by Putin, excludes Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Trump aims to understand how to achieve peace. Zelenskyy insists no agreement is valid without Ukraine's involvement. European allies support Ukraine's stance. Trump will share the meeting's outcome with Zelenskyy and European leaders. The meeting will be held in Alaska.

item.title: 'Third war’ fear: Zelenskyy warns of dire consequences if Russia conquers Donbas; tensions rise ahead of Alaska peace talks
item.description: President Zelenskyy has staunchly refused ceding Donbas to Russia, asserting it would incite further aggression and a potential third war. He voiced concerns over potential demands for Ukrainian withdrawal during upcoming peace talks. While Trump aims to mediate, Zelenskyy insists on security guarantees and EU involvement, dismissing territorial concessions without assurances of lasting peace and sovereignty.

item.title: 'Opportunity to leave': Netanyahu says he 'will allow' Palestinians to exit Gaza during war; says departure will be voluntary
item.description: Amid escalating tensions, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced that Palestinians in Gaza would be allowed to leave as the military prepares for a broader offensive. This option, according to Netanyahu, aims to provide safe passage from combat zones, not forced expulsion. His remarks follow previous controversial suggestions regarding resettlement, drawing criticism reminiscent of the 1948 “Nakba.

item.title: Saudi Arabia: More than 70% of citizens are under 35, says new government report
item.description: A 2024 GASTAT report reveals that 71% of Saudi citizens are under 35, with a median age of 23.5, highlighting a youthful population. Saudi households average five members, with nuclear families most common. Men head 83.1% of households, and apartments are the most popular housing type. The data supports planning aligned with the Kingdom’s development goals.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Age is just a number: 100-year-old WWII veteran flies P-51 Mustang decades after combat missions - Watch video
item.description: A centenarian World War II veteran, Joe Peterburs, relived his past by piloting a P-51 Mustang in California, the same aircraft he flew in 49 combat missions over 70 years ago. The flight, organized by Rumble Over the Redwoods, was an exhilarating experience for Peterburs, who survived capture in WWII and served in the Korean and Vietnam Wars.

item.title: Troubles mount! One in six NRIs on H-1B visas feel threat of US deportation; many thinking of returning to India: Poll
item.description: A growing number of Indian professionals on H-1B visas in the US face unexpected deportation threats post-layoff, even within the 60-day grace period. A recent survey reveals that 16% have received a Notice to Appear (NTA) shortly after job loss, prompting concerns about a potential permanent US ban.
item.dc:creator: TOI Business Desk

item.title: 'Cold civil war': Former NBC host Chuck Todd issues stern warning for America; blames Donald Trump as key driver of political crisis
item.description: Chuck Todd warns the U.S. is heading towards a "cold civil war" due to intense political battles over redistricting, particularly in states like Texas and California. He accuses both parties, especially Trump and the Republicans, of challenging the constitutional system.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Mia Tindall cheers on mum Zara at Hartpury, and her love of horses is clear
item.description: Zara Tindall and her daughter, Mia, were spotted at the NAF Five Star International Hartpury Horse Trials in Gloucestershire. Mia, 11, keenly observed her mother compete with horses Showtime and Class Affair. The event highlighted their shared passion for equestrian sports, a family tradition passed down from Princess Anne and Queen Elizabeth II.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Fort Belvedere explained: Inside the Windsor Great Park home linked to Prince William and Kate Middleton
item.description: Rumors are swirling about a potential move for the Prince and Princess of Wales to Fort Belvedere, a historic property within Windsor Great Park. The fort, once home to Edward VIII and the site of his abdication, offers ample space, privacy, and proximity to local schools and Windsor Castle.

item.title: Italian citizenship: Late-night host Jimmy Kimmel hints at possible relocation; reveals why he’s considering moving to Europe
item.description: Jimmy Kimmel, the American television host, recently revealed that he has obtained Italian citizenship and is contemplating a move to Europe due to his fear of President Donald Trump. He expressed his concerns about the current political climate, noting that it is worse than anticipated.

item.title: UAE: Want to remove traffic black points from your driving licence? Mark this key date
item.description: On August 25, as over a million UAE students return to school, motorists can have four black points removed from their license by driving safely as part of the Ministry of Interior’s “Accident-Free Day” campaign.
